contract: Persist canonical source checkout in clawhip-owned immutable managed state; explicit nonblank update.repo_root wins, operator config is never mutated, and deployment health can use the managed fallback alone.

results.evidence: 15 tests cover Linux checked-fd records, portable Unix publication, explicit and blank precedence, byte-stable operator config, fail-closed malformed/symlink/FIFO handling, hostile-record repair, serialized writers, interrupted publication, bound-directory parent swap, identity-safe cleanup, private directory trust, and canonical git/package/marker validation.
Install and direct update select config loading that skips malformed managed enrichment so lifecycle persistence can repair state; normal commands remain fail-closed.

The install.sh source fallback calls the installed binary's validated recording mode after cargo install, stops on recording failure, creates the managed sidecar, preserves explicit operator repo_root bytes, and does not enable updates or add a channel.
Managed state alone supplies a readable source commit while update.enabled remains false and channel remains absent.
